source: generic reference: a mown pitch soaked by rain, photographed from the main-stand gantry
why: Wet turf throws long specular streaks from each flood bank while the mow stripes stay readable underneath
match: turf roughness drops (about 0.35) so each flood bank leaves an elongated highlight on the grass
mow stripes stay visible as a tint change of about 30 percent, not as hard painted bands
grass shows texture (blade noise) at broadcast distance: pitch luma stddev >= 6
on the dry venues (Favela dust, Lagos sand) the surface stays matte
